id: title:CShine612:sync plausible entry and exit page tables

observations.behavior: Adds a runtime check that raises ValueError when no compatible metrics remain after filtering out event-scoped ones from request dimensions.
observations.posthog_connection: This prevents sending invalid requests to Plausible's API and failing deployments; it also avoids silent failures by raising rather than skipping endpoints.

observations.behavior: Adds tests asserting that each session-scoped breakdown endpoint receives only the allowed session-metrics and rejects configurations with incompatible combinations.
observations.posthog_connection: These checks provide regression protection against configuration drift or future additions of new endpoints breaking compatibility with Plausible's dimension/metric rules.

observations.behavior: Adds an assertion ensuring documented column descriptions match exactly what the connector actually produces for each endpoint.
observations.posthog_connection: This guards documentation consistency and helps catch mismatches between metadata and actual query results without requiring manual review.

observations.limitations: Only this chunk is available. No broader context on warehouse ingestion reliability, recovery behavior, or production failure handling. Tier 3 requires systemic risk reduction across components, which cannot be established here.

review.limitations: Only this chunk is available. No broader context on warehouse ingestion reliability, recovery behavior, or production failure handling. Tier 3 requires systemic risk reduction across components, which cannot be established here.
review.reason: The change adds a bounded correctness improvement: it filters incompatible metrics before requesting them, raises clear errors instead of silently dropping data, and includes targeted assertions and documentation alignment. This demonstrates implementation and relevant checks but does not show broader systemic impact.
review.posthog_relevance: Relevant to PostHog’s warehouse ingestion and reporting; prevents API rejections from Plausible and keeps warehouse queries compatible with its evolving constraints.
review.uncertainty: Assessment relies solely on this chunk; no tests of end-to-end behavior or compatibility against live Plausible responses are visible.
